title: Senior Executive-Admission
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title:**
Senior Executive/ Assistant Manager

**Department:**
Outreach & Admission

**Work Location:**
Sri City, Tada, Andhra Pradesh

**Reporting to:**
Head of Admission

**Position:**
Full -Time

**Experience:**
6 Months – 6 Years

**Educational Qualification**
: Bachelor’s Degree from a premier institution.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

Your responsibilities will include but not limited to:

* Ability to work on a registration deadline, strive towards university-wide applications & enrolment goals and use outstanding customer service to recruit students to the College’s programs.
* Utilize phone, email, and mail to communicate with prospective students in a timely manner, providing superior student service.
* Work with prospective students to garner completed application files prior to enrolment and efforts to increase retention.
* Application evaluation process and coordination with faculties for personal interviews of applicants.
* Maintaining admissions and outreach-related reports and other documents.
* Counselling and supporting students and parents towards admissions in all courses of Krea
* Develop and update a database of teachers, administrators, and contact people with whom workshops and information sessions can be booked.
* Any other task as assigned by the management from time to time.

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates should submit their resume, a cover letter detailing their relevant experience, and contact information
**careers@krea.edu.in**

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
